_comment: Ground truth for the 9.27.25 Pacific Beach event, read by eye.
Keyed by "<card number>:<taxonomy row>" -- card N of the scan, row N of
the spreadsheet template. This key is stable. The labels were originally
keyed by index into out/crops/cells.json, which is rebuilt every time
extract-crops runs; when registration was fixed it found a different set
of cells and those indices silently came to mean different crops.
Values in "labels":
a number   the numeric total written in the TOTAL box
"T"        tally marks rather than a number -- counted, not read
"?"        genuinely ambiguous to a human reader
"resolvedEmpty" lists the 11 cells once marked "X" -- crops that were not
TOTAL boxes at all. They were an artifact of the old registration landing
the box on a section banner, so the reader saw the printed word TOTAL.
Re-cropped after the fix, every one of them is an EMPTY TOTAL box (ink
0.000-0.003 against 0.025 for a written cell), so they are not data that
needs reading -- the tool no longer offers them at all. They are listed
only so the count of 181 reconciles.
This is the measuring stick: a recognizer is scored against it, and the
"?" cells are the ceiling -- nobody should be trusted to beat what a
person can read from the same pixels.
